user.title: Add your DWARF 3
user.description: Start with read-only. You can switch to full control later without losing your dashboards.

menu_options.direct: Read-only: no setup, works alongside the DWARFLAB app
menu_options.relay: Full control: battery, camera and controls (needs the relay app)

direct.title: Your scope
direct.description: Enter the scope's IP address. You can find it in your router's list of devices.

menu_options.discovery_readonly: Add it read-only: nothing to install
menu_options.discovery_full: Add it with full control: sets up the relay app for you

relay.title: Set up the relay
relay.description: The relay is a small Home Assistant app that shares your scope's one connection. It takes about a minute.

menu_options.relay_install: Install and set it up for me
menu_options.relay_manual: I already have a relay running

relay_found.title: Relay found
relay_found.description: The relay is running on this Home Assistant ({host}). Add it?

reconfigure.title: Change how it connects
reconfigure.description: Currently {current}. Your entities and dashboards stay the same when you switch.

menu_options.direct: Read-only, or change the scope's address
menu_options.relay: Full control, or change the relay's address

reauth_confirm.title: The relay wants a token
reauth_confirm.description: Paste the access token from the relay app's settings.

relay_install.title: Your scope's address
relay_install.description: I'll add the DWARF 3 app repository (github.com/bscholer/home-assistant-dwarf3) to Home Assistant, install the relay app, and start it. Enter your scope's IP address, from your router's list of devices.

relay_manual.title: Relay address
relay_manual.description: Where is the relay running? Add the access token only if you turned one on.

menu_options.relay_manual: I'll set up the app myself

error.cannot_connect: Nothing answered at that address. Is the scope awake and on your Wi-Fi?
error.not_a_scope: That answered, but it doesn't look like a DWARF 3.
error.invalid_auth: The relay wants an access token.
error.unsupported_version: This relay is too old or too new for this integration. Update both.
error.unknown: Something unexpected came back. Try again.

abort.not_a_scope: That device is not a DWARF 3.

progress.install_app: Installing the relay app and starting it. This can take a couple of minutes the first time.

goto.name: Go to target
goto.description: Slew to a target and track it. The relay refuses a target near the Sun.

start_capture.name: Start capture
start_capture.description: Start a capture job that stops at the frame count.

start_dark.name: Start darks
start_dark.description: Take dark frames. Close the barrel first.

frames.name: Frames
frames.description: How many dark frames to take.

wide.name: Wide camera
wide.description: Use the wide camera instead of the tele.

move.name: Move
move.description: Move with the joystick for a few seconds.

seconds.name: Seconds
seconds.description: How long to move, up to 5.

point.name: Point
point.description: Move the motors to absolute positions. 172.5 pitch is straight up.

rotation.name: Rotation
rotation.description: 0 to 360. Leave empty to keep it.

delete_session.name: Delete session
delete_session.description: Delete one capture session from the SD card. This cannot be undone. Refused while a capture runs.

session.name: Session
session.description: The folder name, starting with DWARF_RAW_.
